verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the text is tiny and scattered with no shared alignment. The two dashed dividers are stacked together under the body instead of framing it. The booking/website line is illegibly small, and the top third and right side of the canvas are dead space. B builds a deliberate two-column banner, with the dividers framing the body copy on the left and the title, tagline and contact grouped on the right, all readable. However, the headline is pushed to the far top-right and is no more prominent than the body. The two columns don't share a baseline or top edge, and the contact lines sit close to the right edge, so it needs polish.
